questions.question: The LORD told the prophet Jeremiah that he must not marry or have sons or daughters in his land. True or false?
What did the LORD say the sons and daughters born in the prophet Jeremiah's land would die from?

answers.text: A great flood over the land
Fire raining down from the sky

questions.question: The LORD told the prophet Jeremiah that He would remove something from the land in the people's own days. What was it?

answers.text: The sounds of joy and gladness
The walls and gates of the city
The king and his whole army
